title: An unchanged AX target keeps its identity across an unrelated DOM mutation
description: Reads a deterministic AX target, inserts an unrelated sibling, reads the target again, and requires the raw backendDOMNodeId or MCP uid mapping to remain stable.

steps.expression: (() => { const target = document.getElementById('ax-stable'); const inserted = document.createElement('span'); inserted.id = 'ax-unrelated-insert'; inserted.textContent = 'unrelated mutation'; target.before(inserted); return 'mutated'; })()

driver_skips.agent_browser: agent-browser snapshot refs are regenerated observation handles and expose neither backendDOMNodeId nor a documented cross-snapshot stable identity contract
driver_skips.selenium: the cross-engine Selenium/WebDriver route has no standard AX node identity API to compare across mutations
